resources.string: For each line marked to allow, touch the button and accept. Come back here afterwards: the line updates.
If the phone refuses accessibility: open the SENTIA app info, tap the three dots at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
1. Turn on the SENTIA accessibility service. If refused: app info, three dots, Allow restricted settings.\n2. If Volume up three times stops working: turn the accessibility service off and on again.
1. Settings, Apps, SENTIA, Battery saver: choose No restrictions.\n2. Settings, Apps, Permissions, Autostart: turn on SENTIA.\n3. Recent apps (the square): press and hold SENTIA, then touch the lock.

1. Settings, Apps, SENTIA, Battery: choose Unrestricted.
2. Settings, Battery, Background usage limits: turn off Put unused apps to sleep, then add SENTIA to Never sleeping apps.
3. Recent apps: touch the SENTIA icon, then Keep open.
4. Accessibility: Settings, Accessibility, Installed apps, SENTIA.
